# GeoClick Capture 1.3.0 — Search & Capture

GeoClick Capture now supports a bidirectional location workflow in QGIS: map clicks can still be reverse-geocoded, while addresses, place names, coordinates and supported map URLs can now be reviewed and inserted as auditable point records.

## Highlights

- New **Search & Capture** tab beside the Capture Log.
- Address and place-name search through OpenStreetMap Nominatim.
- Decimal coordinate input parsed locally.
- OpenStreetMap and Google Maps URL coordinate extraction.
- Country-code and current-map-extent restrictions for text searches.
- Result zoom, preview, coordinate copying and external map links.
- Auditable insertion into the active capture session.
- New provenance fields for input method, query, provider, result ID, result label/type/importance and OSM identifiers.
- In-memory search cache, timeout, safe redirects, one transient retry and explicit OpenStreetMap attribution.
- Seven new SVG icons aligned with the existing visual system.
- New pure-Python tests for input parsing and Nominatim response normalisation.

Existing snapping, session management, reverse geocoding, record review and CSV/GeoJSON/GeoPackage export remain available.
